text:
priya: Heads-up — I'm going to pause the v2 canary traffic for mobile until we confirm telemetry thresholds and a release-note blurb. seeing a slightly higher 500-rate on short-chat flows :thinking:
alex_m: noted. which metric spike — backend 5xx or route-level errors? can you paste the query? :mag:
dina_r: I saw increased latency on mobile eu region too earlier, likely related to keepalive/small-batch behavior.
priya: query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v2/generate\",status=\"5xx\"}[5m])) by (route)` — it jumped from ~0.02 to 0.2 for ~10m during canary.
priya: not huge but above our canary threshold of 0.1. I want to avoid client impact, mobile team asked to pin if noisy.
alex_m: ok. can we tighten the canary-stage traffic to 2% and extend monitoring window to 30m? that should quiet transient noise.
tj: +1 for lowering to 2%. also recommend enabling automatic rollback on error-rate > 0.15 sustained for 10m.
sam: does rollback trigger exist in deploy-bot? if so what command? :robot_face:
deploy-bot: [deploy] Canaries running: v2-gateway -> 5% traffic -> started by alex_m at 3178901200
deploy-bot: [note] automatic rollback enabled: false
alex_m: deploy-bot, set canary to 2% and enable auto-rollback with threshold 0.15 for 10m.
deploy-bot: command accepted: `set canary v2-gateway 2% --auto-rollback threshold=0.15,duration=10m` (queued)
release-bot: FYI — release notes draft missing mobile callouts. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/58
priya: mobile team asked for explicit compatibility note about header normalization and a tenant pin example.
dina_r: suggest adding this snippet to the notes:
```
If you see higher error rates after upgrade, add header pin in client:
X-API-Version: v1
// then retry with exponential backoff
```
sam: can we also include rollback criteria in the notes so SRE and customers know when to expect a pin? keeps expectations clear.
priya: agreed. action items:
- alex_m: reduce canary to 2% and enable auto-rollback (in progress)
- alex_m / tj: update monitoring dashboard to add 10m sustained 5xx alarm
- sam / dina_r: patch release notes with header pin example and compatibility blurb
- deploy-bot: confirm new canary config applied and auto-rollback active
alex_m: working on it now, will post confirmation when deploy-bot finishes.
deploy-bot: [deploy] updated canary: v2-gateway -> 2% traffic; auto-rollback: enabled(threshold=0.15,duration=10m)
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary config change applied at 3178901500
priya: thanks. I'll hold public release notes until we merge the PR and monitor 30m.
release-bot: PR merged: release-notes#58 by sam at 3178901700
priya: great. we'll let this run for the rest of the window. if error-rate stays <=0.1 and latency stable, we resume standard rollout tomorrow morning.
alex_m: got it. will follow up in morning. :thumbsup:
sam: leaving a note in the mobile internal thread so SDK folks are aware.
priya: closing loop — if auto-rollback fires, we'll pin v1 for affected customers and notify channel.
priya: thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
